content: Namo Mahāmudrāyai!In the spontaneously present celestial palace of the three kāyas,To the glorious Primordial Buddha, the chief of all families,The all-pervading Lord Vajradhara, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Throughout the infinite realms of the ten directions,To the Father who gives birth to the Victors of the three times,The Noble Mañjuśrī of supreme wisdom, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.In this northern Land of Snows,To the second Lord of Sages for the teachings of the Thubpa,The venerable Lobsang Drakpa, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.To Tsongkhapa, the spiritual son of Mañjughoṣa,The foremost holder of the practice lineage teachings,The realized Jampal Gyatso, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Having opened the treasury of the oral lineage instructions,To the one who matures fortunate disciples,Bapo Chökyi Gyaltsen, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Having perfected the yoga of the two stages,And having attained the body of a deathless vidyādhara,To the supreme siddha Dharma Vajra, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Untainted by the fetters of the eight worldly concerns,Holding the victory banner of the teachings of definitive meaning,To Blo bzang don yod grub pa, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Within the delightful palace of the three kāyas,Leading all beings through the dance of the saffron robes,To the scholar-siddha Saṅs rgyas ye shes, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.In the seat of the former realized masters,Arising as a glorious boon for fortunate disciples,To my kind root guru, I pray.Grant your blessings to sever the entanglement of self-grasping,To master love, compassion, and the mind of enlightenment,And to swiftly attain the supreme Mahāmudrā,The path of union.Seeing the guru as a Buddha,Turning away from attachment to cyclic existence,And taking up the burden of liberating all beings,Grant your blessings to swiftly attainThat glorious Mahāmudrā, the path of union,Both common and uncommon.This was spoken by the bhikṣu Blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan. Sarva maṅgalam.
